Chat streaming against real OpenAI API, verifies chunks received

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using LiterLlm;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var apiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OPENAI_API_KEY") ??
  throw new InvalidOperationException("OPENAI_API_KEY must be set");
  using var client = LiterLlmConverter.CreateClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null);
await foreach (var chunk in client.ChatStreamAsync(new ChatCompletionRequest { MaxTokens = 50, Messages = new List<Message>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Message>("{\"content\":\"Count from 1 to 5.\",\"role\":\"user\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, Model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini" }))
  {
      Console.WriteLine(chunk);
  }
```
